question: Calculate the cost to paint a water tank in the shape of a sphere having a radius of 7 cm, if the cost of painting is Rs.4.5/cm² . (π = 22/7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Surface Area of Sphere = 4 × π × r²

Total Area = 4 × (22/7) × 7 × 7 = 616 cm²

Total Cost = Area × Rate = 616 × 4.5

Cost = 616 × (9/2) = 308 × 9 = ₹2772

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2772.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the sphere (r) = 7 cm

Rate of painting = ₹4.5 per cm²

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of Sphere = 4 × π × r²

Total Cost = Surface Area × Rate per unit area

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0331013a402bb9712b5748ca48299fef2f04cc380371c94ac8f2d3f439355278.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × (22/7) × 7 × 7

⇒ Surface Area = 4 × 22 × 7

⇒ Surface Area = 88 × 7 = 616 cm²

⇒ Total Cost = 616 × 4.5

⇒ Total Cost = 616 × (45/10)

⇒ Total Cost = 616 × (9/2)

⇒ Total Cost = 308 × 9

⇒ Total Cost = ₹2772

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2772.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Sphere

The volume of a sphere is given by the formula V = (4/3) × π × r³.

Hemisphere Formulas

Curved Surface Area = 2πr² | Total Surface Area = 3πr² | Volume = (2/3)πr³.

Surface Area Comparison

A sphere has the minimum surface area for a fixed volume compared to any other shape.
